metadata.title: WS1API
metadata.description: PowerShell module for interacting with Omnissa Workspace ONE UEM RestAPI with OAuth support and multi-data center support

findings.title: Network retrieval combined with code execution
findings.description: The same file contains both a network retrieval pattern and a dynamic execution pattern. This combination merits review and is not by itself proof of malicious intent.

findings.title: Separate username and password parameters are declared
findings.description: Function 'Get-ServerAuth' has both Username and Password parameters. Either set the type of the Password parameter to SecureString or replace the Username and Password parameters with a Credential parameter of type PSCredential. If using a Credential parameter in PowerShell 4.0 or earlier, please define a credential transformation attribute after the PSCredential type attribute.
